subject: Request: post-report coverage endorsement & evidence handover for SOC 2 Type II
messages:
From: Laura Chen <laura.chen@arcadiabio.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <k.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-05-10T08:22:00-07:00
Subject: SOC 2 bridge endorsement request — post-report gap

Hi Marissa,

Hope you're doing well. We are finalizing a procurement review for Arcadia's upcoming integration and need an interim endorsement from Redwood to cover the window between your SOC 2 Type II report period end (2026-03-31) and the present. The review team wants a brief signed letter confirming there are no changes to the control environment that would impact the scope since the report end date (a "post-report coverage endorsement" or bridge-style attestation).

What we'd need from you, ideally by Monday 2026-05-18:
- A one-page signed endorsement (DocuSign OK) referencing the 2026-03-31 report end date.
- A redacted copy of the SOC 2 Type II report (if available).
- Any control change summary (high-level) since 2026-03-31 — e.g., major infra changes, KMS rotations, or new 3rd-party subservice providers.

Could you confirm who from Redwood is authorized to sign the endorsement and whether you can provide the items above? If you need a template, we can send one. Our compliance deadline for vendor review is 2026-05-20.

Thanks — appreciate a quick confirmation.

Best,
Laura
Laura Chen
Sr. Security Program Manager
Arcadia Bio

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Laura Chen <laura.chen@arcadiabio.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <k.iyer@redwood.com>, Avery Johnson <avery.johnson@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-05-10T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: SOC 2 bridge endorsement request — post-report gap

Hi Laura — thanks for the note and the timeline. We can do this. Quick answers up front:

- Authorized signatory: Redwood can provide a bridge-style endorsement signed by our VP of Security (Karthik Iyer) or our CFO; please indicate which you prefer.
- Deliverables we can provide: redacted SOC 2 Type II report (2026 reporting period), a short management assertion addressing changes since 2026-03-31, and KMS rotation logs summary.
- Format: DocuSign is fine. We will attach a sample bridge letter for your review (stub attached).

Before we proceed, two clarifying questions:
1) Do you need the full control testing results or just the redacted report + management assertion?
2) Is Arcadia comfortable with redaction of customer and third-party identifying details?

Assuming redactions are acceptable, target timeline: we can get the redacted report + management assertion to you by 2026-05-14 and the signed endorsement executed by 2026-05-18. If you need faster turnaround for DocuSign, flag and we'll prioritize.

Attached: sample-bridge-letter.pdf (template).

Best regards,
Marissa Cole
Director, Compliance & Trust
Redwood Inference

From: Marcus Flynn <marcus.flynn@arcadiabio.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Laura Chen <laura.chen@arcadiabio.com>
Date: 2026-05-11T07:14:00-07:00
Subject: Re: SOC 2 bridge endorsement request — post-report gap

Hi Marissa / Laura — looping in here as Arcadia's CISO. We prefer the endorsement to be signed by the VP-level security leader (Karthik Iyer) rather than finance. Applicable ask from our procurement/compliance team: please include in the package

- Redacted SOC 2 Type II report (PDF)
- Management assertion addressing any control changes since 2026-03-31 (one page)
- KMS key rotation summary (CSV or PDF) covering 2026 Q1–Q2
- Confirmation that no new subservice providers were added to the in-scope systems since the report date

Also, please confirm whether Redwood can provide a short exception memo if there were any minor operational changes (e.g., network maintenance, minor config changes) and whether such changes are considered non-material. Our compliance team needs the full package to clear the integration by 2026-05-20.

Thanks — Marcus
Marcus Flynn
CISO, Arcadia Bio

From: Karthik Iyer <k.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Marcus Flynn <marcus.flynn@arcadiabio.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Laura Chen <laura.chen@arcadiabio.com>
Date: 2026-05-11T15:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: SOC 2 bridge endorsement request — post-report gap

Marcus / Laura / Marissa — thanks for the guidance. I can sign the endorsement for Arcadia. Operational updates:

- We will provide: redacted SOC 2 Type II (2026 period) — filename: redwood-soc2-type2-redacted.pdf; management assertion (one page) covering scope and material changes; KMS rotation log summary (kms-rotation-log-2026Q1.csv); and a short control-change memo (if any items exceed routine maintenance).
- There have been two infrastructure updates since 2026-03-31: consolidation of a development logging bucket into our central observability project (no change to access controls), and a scheduled KMS key rotation on 2026-04-15 (rotation logs attached). Neither change impacted control effectiveness for the audited services.
- We'll prepare the DocuSign envelope and share the link by end of day 2026-05-12. Expect the full package by 2026-05-14.

Attaching now: redwood-soc2-type2-redacted.pdf (redacted copy), kms-rotation-log-2026Q1.csv (summary).

If Arcadia needs to speak to our audit firm, we can introduce Pivotal Audits; we will coordinate an NDA if required.

Karthik Iyer
VP, Security
Redwood Inference
